ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with approximately 5% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels distributed as discrete speckles and distal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity field across both lobes. High-intensity pixels are localized as sub-10px speckles across the ventral surface, with high-contrast clusters concentrated at the distal tips and along the trailing margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 12% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the primary boundary. A distinct rectangular-profile negative space indentation (notch) is located on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe (image right) adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a primary concave curvature from the median notch to the tips; leading edges show a continuous convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups (white-on-black) visible at the distal tip of the left lobe and along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (light-colored scratches) visible primarily on the right lobe, oriented diagonally to the horizontal axis of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent rectangular indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe; significant textured pixel clusters consistent with barnacle colonization on the distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of 3D-textured, high-contrast pixel clusters on the right lobe tip, indicating extant epibiotic attachment (barnacles).
